symbols.name: SqlServerDbContextFactory
symbols.summary: Creates fresh caller-owned SQL Server contexts from independent immutable options and singleton-compatible host services.
symbols.remarks: Creation never opens a database connection. Every returned context is unpooled and must be disposed by its caller. Context constructors must not require request-scoped services from this singleton factory.
